text:
nina: Weird bug in the JS SDK sample: jsonMode + toolcall returns parsed {} after an auth refresh. Repro below.

rachel: Ugh, that sounds like the parse step got skipped. Which SDK version?

nina: sdk@0.24.3 in the starter-kit. Minimal repro: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true });
const r = await client.callTool('profile.get', { userId: 'u1' }, { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { name: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['name'] } });
console.log('parsed', r.parsed);
```
If the access token is expired the first request -> 401, client refreshes, then second attempt returns 200 with correct JSON. Expect parsed.name but get parsed === {}.

tom: Does the raw body on the successful retry contain the JSON? If yes then the bug is in the parsing guard.

nina: I checked: rawBody on the retried response is correct. The parser seems to have an internal early-exit guard if an auth error was seen previously.

kevin: I remember a similar pattern in the retry layer where we set a transient flag on error and some later code does `if (hadAuthError) return cachedEmpty` to avoid double-parse. That was supposed to be only for streaming abort paths.

rachel: Workaround for folks hitting this in onboarding: disable jsonMode in the starter kit or do `const parsed = JSON.parse(res.rawBody)` when you detect empty parsed object. Not ideal.

kevin: Proposed fix: clear transient error flags in the HTTP client retry loop before handing the final response to the parser. Also add a targeted unit that simulates 401->refresh->200 with schema validation.

tom: Also add an integration test for chunked responses: streaming + auth refresh could fail differently. Might need to flush buffered chunks before retry.

nina: Filing an issue and linking the starter-kit README so new contributors don't hit this during first-run. I'll add the manual-parse snippet as a temporary note.

devex-bot: Issue created: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/1344 - "jsonMode parsed empty object after auth refresh in tool call" by nina. Labels: devex, bug, needs-triage.

rachel: Thanks @nina. When someone picks this up, please also glance at Python/Go SDKs for parity. We don't want the same onboarding footgun across languages.

nina: Will do. I'll follow the PR and remove the README workaround once it's fixed. :thumbsup:
